snippet.title: [UE5] RAVENOUS Gameplay Trailer - Student game
snippet.description:
RAVENOUS is now available on steam for free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873400/RAVENOUS/

RAVENOUS is a first-person narrative psychological horror game, where you play as Louis, a child trapped in the depths of a basement designed by a monster who seems to know everything about you. You are alone. Trapped. And your little sister is waiting for you somewhere in the darkness.

GAME FEATURES 
- Explore a gloomy Victorian basement with unique rooms and atmospheres.
- A mysterious storyline filled with clues that take you to the heart of a family drama.
- Gameplay based on exploration and reflection: each room is a psychological puzzle to solve.  
- Available in French, English, and Korean, compatible with keyboard and XBOX controller.  

ESCAPE THE NIGHTMARE
- You are harmless. All you have is your intelligence, your courage, and the hope of seeing the light of day again.
- Find your sister, or lose yourself forever in this labyrinth shaped by grief and hunger.

INFORMATIONS
Ravenous is a French student project from the Esma Game school. The project was made in 6 months, from conception to completion. The team is made up of 7 students who can be found in the authors and credits.
